MissionSettings.Blurb: This is it. If you can defeat the Elite Guard and destroy the Mandrissa's Palace, Liao's hold on this planet will come to an end. Once that happens, the people will realize that they, not the noble Houses, are the true rulers of Carver V. Then, with the support of the populace, we can move against Colonel Renard and House Steiner.We need a victory, Commander. I'll leave the details to you and your staff.
